own_solution.law: Uniform-gravity projectile motion: H = h0 + (v sin theta)^2 / (2g)
assumptions: launch from top of 5 m platform

T4C78.regime: ceiling height above the apex (26 m > 13.43 m); ball does not reach the ceiling

T5047.regime: ceiling height above the apex (26 m > 13.43 m); ball does not reach the ceiling

notes: v_y = 20 sin40 = 12.856 m/s; rise = 12.856^2/19.6 = 8.432 m; H = 13.43 m, or 15.63 m with a 2.2 m stand under the platform. T7618 and TB71A say 'a small stand' with no number, so if they are meant as variants of the 2.2 m sentences they differ in the number; this matters only for any claimed minimal pairing. T161A ('was fitted ... before the ball was launched') is read as the stand still being in place at launch. Mass cancels in projectile kinematics (C).
